text.tspan: : square base cell 43 × 43 mm, gap 3 mm; a panel spans n cells
width of n cells = n × 43 + (n − 1) × 3 mm
Double column: 4 cells (181 mm) + 1 mm margin each side = 183 mm. Single column: 2 cells = 89 mm.
Row height = 43 mm for one-cell rows; n-cell rows follow the same formula (2 cells high = 89 mm).
Fonts do not change with span: ticks 7 pt, axis titles 8 pt, panel letters 10 pt bold lowercase; a single 2×2 panel (89×89 mm) uses +2 pt.
tick labels 9 pt · axis titles 10 pt
applies only when this one 89 × 89 mm panel
is the whole figure; 89 × 43 panels keep
Single column has no extra margin: 43 + 3 + 43 = 89 mm. Only the 2×2 panel (89×89 mm) above uses +2 pt fonts.
